records.translation: pause 500/playMusic ocean/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/loadActors MainEvent/addTemporaryActor Governor 16 32 24 9 2/warpFarmers 24 18 0 28 18 0 32 15 3 26 19 0 20 19 0 15 10 1 15 13 1 34 11 3 right 29 5 2/showFrame Maru 31/showFrame Penny 34/positionOffset Maru 8 24/positionOffset Penny 0 24/positionOffset Jodi 0 16/positionOffset Kent? 8 16/positionOffset Clint 0 -24/positionOffset Haley -8 12/viewport 24 11 true/pause 2000/faceDirection Lewis 3/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 2/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 1/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 2/speak Lewis "大家好，歡迎各位！我很高興宣布百家湯儀式正式開始。#$b#我非常期待大家都帶來了高品質的食材！我們可得給州長留下好印象。"/pause 1000/faceDirection Lewis 3/pause 500/speak Lewis "那麼……州長？能否請您賞光，第一位品嘗這碗湯？"/pause 500/speak Governor "我很樂意！整個下午都在盯著這碗湯呢。"/playMusic none/pause 500/move Governor 0 1 2/pause 1000/playSound dwop/showFrame Governor 8 true/pause 1000/animate Governor false false 200 8 8 9 10 11 11/pause 1100/playSound sipTea/pause 1000/playSound gulp/pause 500/showFrame Governor 8 true/animate Governor false false 200 11 10 9 8/pause 900/speak Governor "……$h"/pause 300/cutscene governorTaste/null

pause 500/playMusic none/pause 500/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/loadActors MainEvent/warpFarmers 27 69 0 27 67 1 32 67 3 28 71 0 26 71 0 25 63 2 32 63 2 34 63 2 left 33 71 0/pause 1000/viewport 27 67 true unfreeze/pause 2000/speak Lewis "今天的節慶終於來到重頭戲……一年一度的春季尋蛋活動！$h"/pause 100/jump Jas/jump Vincent/pause 1000/speak Lewis "孩子們，先冷靜一下。想找到最多彩蛋、把獨家獎品帶回家，就得保留所有體力。"/pause 100/faceDirection Vincent 3 true/faceDirection Jas 1 true/pause 1000/faceDirection Vincent 0 true/faceDirection Jas 0/pause 800/faceDirection Lewis 3/faceDirection Lewis 2/faceDirection Lewis 1/faceDirection Lewis 2/pause 800/speak Lewis "那麼……大家準備好了嗎？"/pause 1000/waitForOtherPlayers startContest/jump Lewis/pause 1000/speak Lewis "尋蛋活動開始！$h"/advancedMove Maru false -2 0 0 6 -9 0 0 -2 -9 0 0 -1 2 0 0 -12 6 0 0 -7 3 0/advancedMove Abigail false 0 21 -20 0 0 3 7 0 0 -15 -9 0 9 0 0 18/advancedMove Jas false 0 12 8 0 0 10 3 0 0 4 14 0 0 -20 -6 0 0 3/advancedMove Sam false 4 0 0 -4 2 0 0 -4 12 0 0 -6 19 0 0 20 0 -20 0 20/advancedMove Vincent false 0 3 24 0 0 21 9 0 0 4 -20 0 20 0 -20 0/advancedMove Leo false 0 -10 -1 0 0 -3 -6 0 0 -2 -3 0 0 -3 -1 0 0 20 -5 0 0 -10 -2 0/playSound whistle/playMusic tickTock/playerControl eggHunt

playful/7 4/farmer 7 12 0 Sam 7 5 0 Jodi 17 7 0/skippable/move farmer 0 -6 0/faceDirection Sam 2/pause 300/speak Sam "哦，嗨，@。我正要吃點心。"/pause 500/speak Sam "來，我也拿點東西給你。"/faceDirection Sam 0/pause 500/playSound openBox/pause 500/faceDirection Sam 3/playSound dwop/specificTemporarySprite dropEgg/showFrame Sam 33/jump Sam/pause 1000/emote Sam 12/showFrame Sam 12/speak Sam "哦，不……弄得一團糟。$s"/speed Jodi 4/move Jodi -10 0 0/speak Jodi "剛才是什麼聲音？"/emote Jodi 16/speak Jodi "*倒抽一口氣*$s"/move Jodi -1 0 0/move Jodi 0 -1 0/speak Jodi "這也太糟糕了！發生什麼事？$u"/speak Sam "$q 80 null#……告訴她吧，@。$s#$r 80 -10 event_snack1#山姆把點心遞給我時掉了。#$r 80 50 event_snack2#山姆把點心遞給我，然後是我掉的。#$r 81 -50 event_snack3#山姆故意丟下去的。他覺得這樣很好笑。"/pause 300/speak Jodi "$p 80#謝謝你告訴我真相，@。這不是什麼大事。|山姆，你做了什麼？！你到底怎麼了？！$u"/faceDirection Jodi 0/speak Sam "媽媽，對不起。我會清乾淨。$s"/emote Jodi 20/speak Jodi "謝謝，親愛的。$h"/move Jodi 0 1 1/move Jodi 1 0 2 /faceDirection Sam 2 true/move Jodi 0 7 2 true/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end dialogue Sam "$p 81#我在生你的氣。完全不懂你為什麼要那樣說謊。$s|之前發生的事，對不起。"

distantBanjo/3 6/farmer -2000 -2000 0 Lewis 1 6 0/skippable/pause 2000/warp farmer 5 11/playSound doorClose/pause 400/move farmer 0 -5 0/move farmer -3 0 3/pause 400/faceDirection Lewis 1/pause 500/emote Lewis 16/speak Lewis "啊，你好，@。"/pause 500/faceDirection Lewis 0/speak Lewis "我剛才正在往這臺機器裡裝更多獎品……"/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 0/emote farmer 8/pause 500/speak Lewis "這是我想出的新方案，希望在鎮民之間提倡互助友愛的精神……當然也包括你！#$b#方法很簡單……有時候在鎮上幫助別人後，你會收到一張「獎品券」。可以用它們兌換獎勵。#$b#裡面有些很特別的東西！$h"/pause 500/emote farmer 56/faceDirection Lewis 1/emote Lewis 40/speak Lewis "我唯一擔心的是，大家只會追逐獎品券，而不是真心培養對他人的關懷……$s"/faceDirection farmer 3/quickQuestion #我只是想幫忙。#沒錯，我就是為了獎品。(break)pause 100\emote Lewis 32\speak Lewis "真的嗎？很高興聽你這麼說！$h"(break)pause 50\jump Lewis\pause 500\speak Lewis "我明白了！$u#$b#嗯……這不是我希望聽見的答案，但謝謝你坦白。"/pause 500/speak Lewis "總之……記得多看看鎮上的「徵求幫手」布告欄。那是取得更多獎品券的好方法。#$b#祝你好運。"/pause 500/end

50s/6 20/farmer -10 -10 0 Haley 5 20 1 Emily 8 20 3/skippable/pause 1000/shake Haley 500/pause 500/speak Haley "呃啊！每次都是我清理坐墊下面！這星期輪到你了！$a"/emote Emily 12/speak Emily "你太幼稚了，海莉。這間房子絕大多數的家務都是我做的，你明明知道。$u"/pause 200/warp farmer 2 24/playSound doorClose/pause 400/faceDirection Haley 2/faceDirection Emily 2/speak Haley "哦，是那個新來的${farm boy^girl from the farm}$。$7"/faceDirection Emily 3/speak Emily "${He^She}$有名字好嗎。$u"/move farmer 0 -1 1/move farmer 3 0 0/faceDirection Emily 2/speak Haley "嘿，我敢說你會理解我的觀點。"/emote farmer 8/speak Emily "*嘆氣*……真的很抱歉把你牽扯進來，@。我只是請海莉清理坐墊下面，她就在抱怨。$u"/faceDirection Haley 1/speak Haley "$q 45 null#因為上星期才是我清的！$a#$r 46 -50 Event_clean2#別再抱怨了，清乾淨就對了！#$r 45 30 Event_clean1#海莉，何不把這當作你每週唯一的家務？#$r 46 -30 Event_clean3#艾蜜莉，這次就大度一點，幫她做吧。"/fork haleyWontDoIt/stopMusic/faceDirection Haley 3/emote Haley 12/pause 400/faceDirection Haley 1/speak Haley "好啦，你贏了。那就把這當作我每週的家務吧。這樣以後就沒有理由為此爭吵了。$u"/faceDirection Haley 2/speak Emily "謝謝，@。這是很棒的解決辦法。$h"/pause 1000/end

playful/-100 -100/farmer 27 7 2 Alex 25 17 2/showFrame Alex 23/skippable/animate Alex false true 125 16 17 18 19 20 21 22 23 23 23 23 23 23 23 23 23 23 23 23/viewport 28 14 true/move farmer 0 10 2/stopAnimation Alex/showFrame Alex 24/pause 600/showFrame Alex 23/speak Alex "哦，嗨。"/pause 300/emote Alex 40/speak Alex "呃，你是@，對吧？"/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 3/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 2/speak Alex "我只是在享受這麼棒的天氣，@。"/pause 1000/faceDirection Alex 1/pause 500/showFrame Alex 24/speak Alex "嗯……$u#$b#嘿，跑遠一點接球！$h"/pause 500/move farmer 2 0 3/pause 1000/showFrame Alex 4/animate Alex false false 80 24 25 25 26 4/pause 240/playSound throw/animate farmer true true 100 30/specificTemporarySprite joshFootball/null/pause 500/stopAnimation farmer/pause 700/speak Alex "嘿……差一點。"/pause 500/move farmer -2 0 2/pause 800/faceDirection Alex 2/speak Alex "我要成為星露谷第一位職業格球選手……我心裡毫無疑問。#$b#我已經帶領校隊打進地區季後賽……現在只要繼續訓練、變得更強，就能在祖祖市掘地者隊的名單上取得一席之地。你等著看吧！"/pause 1000/question fork1 "#我相信你！#哇，你還真自大。"/fork arrogantJosh/faceDirection Alex 1/pause 500/speak Alex "謝謝，@。我會記住這句話。"/move Alex 1 0 1/pause 500/end dialogue Alex "嘿，剛才很好玩，對吧？"

sampractice/-1000 -1000/farmer 4 15 1 Sam 17 16 2 Sebastian 18 18 0/positionOffset Sebastian 32 -31/skippable/animate Sam false true 200 20 21/showFrame Sebastian 41/viewport 17 16 true/move farmer 8 0 0/pause 500/doAction 12 14/move farmer 0 -2 1/move farmer 4 0 2/pause 9000/stopAnimation Sam/showFrame Sebastian 8/pause 1000/faceDirection Sam 0/pause 800/speak Sam "哦，嗨，@！塞巴斯蒂安和我剛才在「即興合奏」。"/move farmer 0 3 1/faceDirection Sam 3/faceDirection Sebastian 3/speak Sam "我們想組樂團，但還不知道該做哪種音樂。可能性實在太多了。"/pause 500/emote Sebastian 28/faceDirection Sam 2/pause 500/emote Sam 16/faceDirection Sam 3/speak Sam "#$q 76 null#話說，@……你喜歡哪種音樂？#$r 76 50 Event_band1#歡快的流行音樂。#$r 77 50 Event_band2#實驗噪音搖滾。#$r 78 50 Event_band3#高能量舞曲。#$r 79 50 Event_band4#酒館鄉村音樂。"/move Sam 0 2 1/speak Sam "你覺得呢，塞巴斯蒂安？要做這種嗎？"/pause 300/faceDirection Sebastian 0/pause 300/faceDirection Sebastian 3/speak Sebastian "……好吧。"/pause 500/faceDirection Sam 0/move Sam 0 -2 3/speak Sam "謝謝你幫忙，@。有我的吉他技巧，再加上塞巴斯蒂安在合成器上的魔法，我們一定會一鳴驚人。這點我深信不疑！$h"/faceDirection Sam 2/speak Sam "現在只差一個鼓手了……$u"/pause 500/end

EmilyTheme/22 88/farmer -1000 -1000 2 Emily -1000 -1000 2/skippable/pause 4000/playSound doorClose/warp Emily 20 89/move Emily 0 1 2/pause 800/speak Emily "啊……鵜鶘鎮又迎來美好的一天。"/pause 2000/faceDirection Emily 1/specificTemporarySprite parrots1/pause 1000/showFrame Emily 32/jump Emily/pause 1200/showFrame Emily 4/pause 600/playSound parrot/pause 800/playSound parrot/pause 600/faceDirection Emily 2 true/animate Emily false true 250 34 35/pause 3500/stopAnimation Emily/faceDirection Emily 3/pause 1000/textAboveHead Emily "我的朋友們！"/pause 4000/move Emily 2 0 1/pause 800/emote Emily 8/specificTemporarySprite parrotSplat/showFrame Emily 32/shake Emily 1000/waitForTempSprite 666/specificTemporarySprite parrotSlide/pause 800/speed Emily 4/move Emily 2 0 0/speak Emily "哦，不！可憐的小傢伙！$s"/pause 1000/playSound coin/specificTemporarySprite parrotGone/showFrame Emily 30/pause 1000/speak Emily "你的翅膀斷了。$s"/pause 1000/animate Emily false true 300 28 29 28 30/pause 3000/speak Emily "哦，你和其他鳥有點不一樣，對吧？就像我一樣……$u"/pause 2000/speak Emily "別擔心。我會照顧你恢復健康，小傢伙。一切都會好起來的。$u"/pause 2000/globalFade/viewport -3000 -3000/pause 1000/message "艾蜜莉把受傷的鸚鵡帶回家，替牠包紮翅膀。"/pause 800/message "牠在艾蜜莉的房間裡安頓好了。不過為了表示尊重，她沒有替這隻鳥取名字。"/pause 1000/playSound parrot/pause 1000/end

ocean/6 8/farmer -1000 -1000 0 Willy -1000 -1000 0/skippable/pause 4000/warp farmer 6 12/playSound doorClose/move farmer 0 -2 0/emote farmer 8/pause 1500/warp Willy 6 12/playSound doorClose/move Willy 0 -1 0/pause 500/emote Willy 28/pause 250/move farmer 1 0 0/move Willy 0 -1 0/pause 700/speak Willy "是啊……看了很傷心，對吧？"/pause 500/speak Willy "這是我父親的船……為他效力了50多年。#$b#但現在幾乎連漂在水面上都辦不到了。$s"/faceDirection Willy 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Willy "我很想親手修好，但沒有合適的材料，小伙子。^我很想親手修好，但沒有合適的材料，小姐。"/faceDirection Willy 0/speak Willy "是啊……先用200塊硬木修補船身，是個好起點。#$b#但還得修復售票機和銥製船錨。"/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 400/speak Willy "要是能取得合適的材料，修好這位老姑娘……那我就能帶你前往蕨島。"/faceDirection Willy 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Willy "聽說那裡是充滿奇特鸚鵡的火山島……"/pause 400/quickQuestion #我願意幫忙#算了，我不參加……(break)emote Willy 32\speak Willy "是啊……我就知道你會答應，小伙子。^是啊……我就知道你會答應，小姐。$h"\speak Willy "我會讓這扇門保持不上鎖……隨時都可以把材料送來。"(break)emote Willy 28\speak Willy "好吧，隨你高興……$s#$b#如果改變心意，隨時可以回來幫忙。總之我會讓這扇門保持不上鎖。"/pause 2000/end

nightTime/68 84/farmer 65 79 1 Lewis 69 83 1 Marnie 69 84 0/skippable/pause 500/faceDirection Lewis 2/pause 200/emote Lewis 28/speak Lewis "瑪妮……我們不能這樣。消息一旦傳開，可能會削弱我在鎮上的權威地位！$s"/pause 300/faceDirection Marnie 1/emote Marnie 12/speak Lewis "你明白……對吧？$s"/pause 1000/speak Marnie "路易斯，你太在意工作了。人生中還有其他事，你知道的。$u"/faceDirection Marnie 2/pause 500/speak Marnie "……不過，對，我明白。看來我們只能把……我們的關係……當作祕密。$s"/pause 600/playSound leafrustle/faceDirection Marnie 3 true/faceDirection Lewis 3 true/showFrame Lewis 24/showFrame Marnie 16/jump Lewis/jump Marnie/shake Lewis 2000/shake Marnie 2000/move farmer 4 0 2/showFrame Lewis 12/showFrame Marnie 12/faceDirection Lewis 0/faceDirection Marnie 0/emote Lewis 16/speak Marnie "呀！$4"/pause 800/speak Lewis "$q 200 null#@……剛才的話你全聽見了，對吧？$s#$r 200 50 event_secret1#對……但我會保密。#$r 201 -100 event_secret2#對……而且我要告訴所有人。"/pause 800/move Marnie 0 1 2/pause 800/faceDirection Marnie 3/faceDirection farmer 2/speak Marnie "話說回來，你為什麼躲在那裡？$u"/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 300/jump farmer/pause 1000/speed farmer 4/move farmer -4 0 3/speed farmer 4/move farmer 0 -2 3/speed farmer 4/move farmer -3 0 3/playSound leafrustle/pause 600/faceDirection Lewis 2/faceDirection Marnie 0/pause 300/emote Lewis 8 true/emote Marnie 8 true/pause 1000/end

pause 1000/playMusic ocean/speak Governor "嗯……有點酸……但味道其實非常不錯！"/pause 600/emote Governor 8/speak Governor "等一下……我的碗裡有東西……這是什麼？$2"/pause 500/showFrame Governor 14/playSound slimeHit/jump Governor/pause 500/showFrame Lewis 24/jump Lewis/textAboveHead Lewis "什麼？！"/showFrame Emily 26/pause 1000/showFrame Marnie 16/jump Marnie/textAboveHead Marnie "*倒抽一口氣*"/pause 1000/shake Governor 2000/emote Governor 12/pause 500/showFrame Emily 4/showFrame Marnie 8/speak Governor "這……這太離譜了！$1#$b#我這輩子從未受過如此侮辱！$1"/pause 600/showFrame Governor 13/playSound throw/specificTemporarySprite luauShorts/pause 500/jump Lewis/pause 1000/speak Governor "呸……我的舌頭腫起來了……我好像快吐了。$u"/pause 400/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 1000/warp Governor -100 -100/playSound slimedead/faceDirection Lewis 2/viewport Lewis clamp true/pause 1000/speak Lewis "參與這種駭人行為的人實在罪不可赦。竟把我極其私人的物品用在這種病態的用途上！$4#$b#還毀了原本好好的一鍋湯……不可原諒！我從未如此以這個社區為恥……真令人作嘔。$4"/pause 500/faceDirection Lewis 0/emote Lewis 12/speak Lewis "回家吧，節日結束了。$s"/pause 500/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/message "看來這個「小惡作劇」不太受歡迎……"/pause 500/message "該回家了。"/waitForOtherPlayers festivalEnd/end

pause 400/speak Elliott "在書桌前塗寫了無數個小時後，我要向各位發表第一本書：《藍塔》……這是一部以超現實反烏托邦未來為背景的推理小說。"/animate Elliott false true 1000 33 33 34/pause 500/speak Elliott "第一章。#$b#一名男子從陰影中走出，散發著洞悉萬物的神祕氣息。「晚安，盧先生。」他說，嘴角微微顫抖。盧似乎大吃一驚。「你怎麼知道我的名字？」"/playMusic none/globalFade/viewport -100 -100/pause 1000/warp Sebastian -1000 -1000/warp Sam -1000 -1000/warp Abigail -1000 -1000/warp Jodi -1000 -1000/warp Robin -1000 -1000/warp Demetrius -1000 -1000/warp Shane -1000 -1000/warp Maru -1000 -1000/warp Pierre -1000 -1000/warp Caroline -1000 -1000/viewport 14 11 true/pause 1000/speak Elliott "盧檢查了傑努的口袋，隨後站起身走進臥室。他很快找到自己在尋找的小金鑰匙，並把它塞進大衣口袋。"/stopAnimation Elliott/showFrame Elliott 34/pause 800/speak Elliott "好了，朗讀就到這裡。我會在櫃檯旁販售親筆簽名的書。謝謝各位聆聽！$h"/faceDirection Lewis 3/faceDirection Marnie 1/faceDirection Emily 2 true/faceDirection Clint 1/move Elliott 0 4 3/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 600/speak Elliott "嗯，感覺怎麼樣？"/emote farmer 32/speak Elliott "謝謝。$h#$b#你知道嗎，我從你那裡得到了創作推理故事的靈感。記得嗎？#$b#所以我把這本書獻給你……$l"/move Elliott -1 0 3/emote Elliott 32/pause 1000/end

echos/-1000 -1000/farmer 13 6 3 Abigail 6 8 1/skippable/specificTemporarySprite abbyOuijaCandles/viewport 7 5/speak Abigail "嘿！我一直希望你會出現。想給你看樣東西。"/move farmer -5 0 0/move farmer 0 2 3/faceDirection Abigail 2/speak Abigail "看到這個了嗎？它叫通靈板。你以前用過嗎？"/emote farmer 8/move Abigail 0 2 1/move farmer 0 2 3/pause 500/speak Abigail "把手和我的手一起放在乩板上……$l"/showFrame Abigail 30/pause 200/animate farmer true true 9999 89/pause 600/speak Abigail "現在靈魂會引導我們走向一個……$h"/showFrame Abigail 31/pause 500/speak Abigail "快看，它在動！$7"/emote farmer 16/speak Abigail "第一個字母是……「I」……"/pause 600/speak Abigail "接著是……「<」……"/pause 800/speak Abigail "哇，看它動得多快！正在拼出……「%firstnameletter」……#$b#I < %firstnameletter……？"/emote Abigail 16/showFrame Abigail 12/faceDirection Abigail 3/stopMusic/pause 200/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection Abigail 1/pause 400/specificTemporarySprite abbyOuija/playSound swordswipe/pause 900/playSound seeds/pause 500/speak Abigail "哎呀，不小心把通靈板打翻了！嘿嘿……$h#$b#這只是個蠢遊戲，沒有任何意義。$9"/faceDirection Abigail 3/emote Abigail 60/faceDirection Abigail 1/speak Abigail "我，呃，還有事要做。你得走了……抱歉。$9"/faceDirection Abigail 2/emote farmer 28/pause 500/move farmer 0 -3 0/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 1000/move farmer 5 0 1 true/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end invisibleWarpOut Abigail

sadpiano/17 17/farmer 10 19 1 George 18 17 0/skippable/emote George 12/speak George "嗯嗯嗯……我就是搆不到！$u#$b#要是能從這張該死的椅子上站起來就好了……$s"/move farmer 4 0 0/move farmer 0 -2 0/move farmer 3 0 0/pause 500/showFrame 15/pause 500/pause 500/playSound Ship/pause 500/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection farmer 1/faceDirection George 3/showFrame 35/pause 500/playSound coin/pause 300/stopAnimation farmer/pause 500/speak George "謝了，年輕人。^謝了，小姐。"/pause 800/speed George 1/faceDirection George 2/pause 500/move George 0 1 2/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 1000/speak George "*嘆氣*……那是30年前的事了。$s#$b#當時我在煤礦工作。快要下班時，只剩最後一條礦脈還得炸開。#$b#我拿著一根炸藥進去準備引爆，但腳滑進裂縫，手裡的炸藥也掉了。炸藥一碰地就爆炸。"/pause 800/speak George "接下來有印象的事，就是我躺在醫院裡……他們告訴我這輩子再也走不了路。"/faceDirection George 3/speak George "所以事情就是這樣。你大概以為我只是老得走不動了。#$b#不過我告訴你，要不是那場意外，我現在還會活蹦亂跳得像隻小雞！"/faceDirection George 2/speak George "……"/move farmer 0 1 1/pause 1700/speak George "年輕人，你一直對我很好。我很感激。^小姐，你一直對我很好。我很感激。#$b#人老了，就會開始忘記還有人關心自己。"/pause 800/faceDirection George 3/pause 1000/end
